messages.author: Husak Michal
messages.body:
Hi
Is there any direct contact to Antechamber developers possible ?
I work with this part of the code intensively and I had found multiple bugs
and issues both in the source code and in the configuration files.
Most people in this forum are probably not interested in the details,
so I do not want to spam the list by complex issues description.
I would prefer comunication with somebody working on Antechamber maintance and development.
Michal Husak
UCT Prague ...
